title: Empty Chairs
set_language: ONE persistent 1869 chemist desk DNA ONLY: honey wood desk, soft warm lamp, cream blank cards, night window. Same desk DNA every scenery plate — camera moves only; do not reset furniture layout; do not invent a new room or model-town.
continuity_lock: HARD: every scenery plate MUST match plate 01 desk DNA (honey wood + soft lamp + cream blank cards + night window). Prefer I2V from plate-01 frames / same-desk stills. Camera moves only. No furniture layout reset.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: model-town sprawl, glowing yellow house-blocks, black house icons/map pins, central-table town diorama, Orbit robot, photoreal, vessel fire, clear liquid glass, Ken Burns only, academic-blazer Explorer, layout reset that dumps desk DNA.
